claims: The 2026 Lyrical Lemonade Summer Smash will be held from June 12–14, 2026.
The 2026 Lyrical Lemonade Summer Smash will be held at SeatGeek Stadium in Bridgeview, Illinois.
Headliners for the 2026 Lyrical Lemonade Summer Smash are Playboi Carti, Lil Uzi Vert, Skrillex, Chief Keef, Baby Keem, and Bladee x Yung Lean.
Other acts for the 2026 Lyrical Lemonade Summer Smash are Sexyy Red, Lil Baby, G Herbo, Lucki, BigXthaPlug, Fetty Wap, Waka Flocka, Molly Santana, Lil Skies, RiFF RaFF, and North West.
Tickets for the 2026 Lyrical Lemonade Summer Smash go on sale April 14, 2026, at 2 p.m. CT.
Tickets for the 2026 Lyrical Lemonade Summer Smash are available on thesummersmash.com.
The 2026 Lyrical Lemonade Summer Smash is in its eighth year.
